all-layer source copying followed by replay of the later prompt.
$SC_{\mathrm{exact}}$ explicitly rewrites every source K/V tensor after
$SC$. Runtime elementwise checks find zero source discrepancies at all

Complete-prefix copying reproduces every donor sequence in both contexts
($1{,}160/1{,}160$ pairs). It is a positive control using same-question
donor computation, not an efficient reuse method. Replay also uses donor
source KV and recomputes all prompt positions after the skill. It restores
accuracy close to the donor but is not a numerical identity
(Table~\ref{tab:state-baselines}). On Qwen/TheoremQA it gives $62/63$
correct versus the donor's $61/63$; this one-item improvement does not
make replay equivalent to the donor. Different BF16 prefill computation
shapes can change individual token predictions.

and paired interval, without downloading answer text or rerunning inference.
